description: This file implements directory reading functions for Windows, mimicking POSIX dirent.h functionality, including opendir, closedir, and readdir_r, with internal management of directory entries and synchronization.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A wrapper around Windows CRITICAL_SECTION for thread synchronization.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a unique file descriptor integer.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores a directory entry list associated with a file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally erases directory entries associated with a file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_replace
methods.description: Replaces the directory entries for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: GetDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Reads directory entries from a Windows directory handle.

methods.name: opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory stream for reading.

methods.name: readdir_r
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry in a thread-safe manner.
